combo_label: At the Opticians × Falconry × The Blitz

entries.clue: Civilian rostered from 1941 to watch a business roof for incendiaries
Light-sensitive layer lining the back of the eye, often photographed
The two side pieces that fold in, hooking the pair over your ears
Steady single note sounded once the raiders had passed over
Casual British shortening for the pair you push back up your nose
Little falcon that hovers above a motorway verge, the bird the old rank-rhyme gave a knave
Feathered dummy swung on a cord to fetch a falcon back down out of the sky
Flap off the glove in fright and hang there upside down by the straps
Bend forward at the shoulders, and the falconer's word for a shut-winged dive
Corrugated steel arch sunk in the garden and covered over with soil
Letters on a warden's badge, standing for air raid precautions
